jun5.name: Jun, the second follower (episode 4, chapter 5)
jun5.note: Sam: a young Singaporean man, easy and friendly; the measured pick of six (masters/v28.0/voices/RECORD.md), until Chad's ear. RMS -16.

koh5.name: Mr Koh, the devotee (episode 4, chapter 5)
koh5.note: Mr David: a middle-aged Malaysian Chinese man; the measured pick of three, until Chad's ear. RMS -16.

collector5.name: The collector (episode 4, chapter 5)
collector5.note: Shawn Ng: a younger Malaysian Chinese man, plain and tired; the measured pick of three, until Chad's ear. RMS -16.

chapter: Episode 4 · Chapter 5 · The House With Nine Prai

rows.where: opening film: over black, a lift's hum
rows.text: [reflective] Case two. A devotee's home. He had been quarrelling with people outside, and at home he could not rest.

rows.where: opening film: inside the lift car
rows.text: [casual] Mr Koh says the lights keep going off. Electrician came three times already.

rows.where: opening film: inside the lift car
rows.text: [amused] He also says he fights with everybody. His own words.

rows.where: opening film: one step out of the lift, the picture sours
rows.text: [uneasy] The doors opened, and it hit me.

rows.where: play, the walkway: he asks Ton
rows.text: [uneasy] Do you smell that?

rows.where: play, the walkway: Ton, asked
rows.text: [puzzled] Smell what?

rows.where: play, the walkway: Ton, after he tries
rows.text: [casual] Nothing, brother.

rows.where: play, the walkway: Jun, asked
rows.text: [amused] Somebody frying fish? No? Then nothing.

rows.where: play, the walkway: both asked
rows.text: [calm] Your nose has opened. They cannot smell it. You can.

rows.where: play, the walkway: both asked; the SMELL button appears
rows.text: [firm] Do not say what it is yet. Follow it. SMELL.

rows.where: play, the walkway: he presses the eye before the devotee's film (once)
rows.text: [gentle] Not yet. First your nose.

rows.where: play, the walkway: the drain's grating
rows.text: [relieved] A drain. That one I understand.

rows.where: play, the walkway: the drain's grating
rows.text: [amused] That one even I can smell.

rows.where: play, the walkway: after the drain
rows.text: [warm] Good. Now the other one.

rows.where: play, the walkway: at the gate
rows.text: [calm] The spiritual sense of your nose is already open. That is why it reached you, and not them.

rows.where: play, the walkway: at the gate
rows.text: [uneasy] We were not even at his door.

rows.where: play, the walkway: he walks on past six metres without asking
rows.text: [concerned] Brother? You all right?

rows.where: play, the walkway: SMELL not pressed, 8 s
rows.text: [firm] SMELL.

rows.where: play, the walkway: SMELL not pressed, 20 s, then every 15 s
rows.text: [calm] Breathe in. SMELL.

rows.where: play, the walkway: SMELL never pressed
rows.text: [casual] Mr Koh's is the one at the end, brother.

rows.where: play, the walkway: he goes back toward the lift (once)
rows.text: [quiet] Weaker here.

rows.where: film, the devotee: at his doors, a wai
rows.text: [anxious] Grandmaster. You came. I did not know who else to ask.

rows.where: film, the devotee: his living room
rows.text: [weary] At night somebody knocks. Inside the house. I check: nobody. My things move. I lie down, I feel a weight, here.

rows.where: film, the devotee: his living room, his hand on his chest
rows.text: [exasperated] Three weeks. My workers say I am short-tempered. I say I am not sleeping!

rows.where: film, the devotee: a breath, lower
rows.text: [ashamed] I know I have a mouth. I have quarrelled with people. More than a few.

rows.where: film, the devotee: to Mr Koh
rows.text: [calm] We will look first.

rows.where: film, the devotee: to his student
rows.text: [calm] Use your nose. Then your Spirit Vision. Tell me what you find, not what you think it is.

rows.where: play, the hunt: under the shoe cabinet by the doors
rows.text: [uneasy] Here, under this. It is dark to me, and the smell is thick.

rows.where: play, the hunt: the court, at the left planter's foot
rows.text: [serious] The same thing. All along here.

rows.where: play, the hunt: the threshold between the gate posts
rows.text: [serious] Here it is strongest. It runs from the gate to his door.

rows.where: play, the hunt: his Spirit Vision first open in the court
rows.text: [serious] Nine Prai.

rows.where: play, the hunt: the nine seen
rows.text: [reflective] They were already there.

rows.where: play, the hunt: the nine seen, stains still unfound
rows.text: [calm] Now find where it was poured.

rows.where: play, the hunt: the three stains found and the nine seen
rows.text: [serious] I believe somebody poured this here: the oil of nine Prai. I believe it was people who are angry with him.

rows.where: play, the hunt: the armchair, his nose behind the truth
rows.text: [gentle] Nothing is there now. A smell stays after what made it has gone.

rows.where: play, the hunt: the armchair
rows.text: [doubtful] My nose was sure.

rows.where: play, the hunt: he idles 25 s (a hint, once)
rows.text: [calm] Try the court.

rows.where: play, the hunt: he idles 25 s (a hint, once)
rows.text: [calm] Try by the door.

rows.where: play, the hunt: he idles 25 s (a hint, once)
rows.text: [calm] Try the gate.

rows.where: play: his Spirit Vision open, the strain red at its top (the hunt and the table)
rows.text: [firm] You're losing control, close your Spirit Vision, and re-open it again.

rows.where: play: his Spirit Vision shut and its strain gone (the hunt and the table)
rows.text: [gentle] When you feel better, open your Spirit Vision again.

rows.where: film, the preparation: to the household behind the thread
rows.text: [serious] Stay behind the thread. Whatever you hear, do not come out.

rows.where: film, the preparation
rows.text: [afraid] What will I hear?

rows.where: film, the preparation: to his student
rows.text: [firm] Stand with me. Do not open to them. Whatever comes, stand.

rows.where: film, the turn: the picture goes to the colour of his protection
rows.text: [awed] And then I was not alone in my body.

rows.where: the fight: at START, before the lesson's first Prai
rows.text: [calm] We do not destroy them, Zavier. We gather them.

rows.where: the fight: the lesson's first Prai; and the short wording of every FIRE need
rows.text: [firm] FIRE.

rows.where: the fight: the lesson: the first Prai chased away (once)
rows.text: [calm] The fire only chases them away. They hide, and they come back.

rows.where: the fight: the short wording of every BIND need
rows.text: [firm] Bind.

rows.where: the fight: need bound, Master Zavier played: first wording (said in the lesson)
rows.text: [calm] It is bound. Now switch to me.

rows.where: the fight: need bound, Grandmaster Pho played: first wording (said in the lesson)
rows.text: [firm] Fire. Then bag it.

rows.where: the fight: need shown, Master Zavier played: first wording (said in the lesson)
rows.text: [urgent] There. BIND it, before it sinks again.

rows.where: the fight: the first golden shockwave, whoever is played: first wording
rows.text: [serious] The golden shockwave is ready. Lend me your cage first.

rows.where: the fight: after the first golden shockwave (once)
rows.text: [calm] The gold gathers what is bound. The rest, it only drives back.

rows.where: the fight: the lesson: the bound Prai tired (once)
rows.text: [calm] A bound Prai cannot run. Now the fire tires it.

rows.where: the fight: the fight proper begins (once)
rows.text: [serious] Now they all come. BIND them, and I will gather them.

rows.where: the fight: need waveB (the gold is ready and nothing is bound): first wording
rows.text: [firm] BIND one first. The gold gathers only what is bound.

rows.where: the fight: a golden shockwave broken in its gathering (each time)
rows.text: [serious] They broke the gold. Lend me your cage before I gather it.

rows.where: the fight: the first hold begins (once)
rows.text: [serious] They draw together. The bag cannot take them now. Only the gold, and only what is bound.

rows.where: the fight: the first BIND refused because three are bound already (once)
rows.text: [gentle] Three is all you can hold. Let me take one.

rows.where: the fight: the last hold begins, at four left (once)
rows.text: [serious] The last of them cling to the house. Only the gold can take them. BIND them, Zavier.

rows.where: the fight: need cage (Grandmaster Pho played; a Prai at the bars, the cage under a third): first wording
rows.text: [urgent] His cage is breaking. FIRE.

rows.where: the fight: need cage: second wording
rows.text: [urgent] Chase them off his cage. FIRE.

rows.where: the fight: need press, Grandmaster Pho played: first wording
rows.text: [urgent] They press at his cage. Switch to Zavier.

rows.where: the fight: need press, Master Zavier played: first wording
rows.text: [urgent] Your cage is wearing thin. BIND them.

rows.where: the fight: need press, Master Zavier played: second wording
rows.text: [firm] Hold them still. BIND.

rows.where: the fight: need bound, Master Zavier played: second wording
rows.text: [firm] Now. Switch to me, and FIRE.

rows.where: the fight: need bound, Master Zavier played: the short one
rows.text: [firm] To me. FIRE.

rows.where: the fight: need tired, Grandmaster Pho played: second wording
rows.text: [firm] BAG the tired Prai before it rises.

rows.where: the fight: need tired: the short one; and the last three
rows.text: [firm] Bag it.

rows.where: the fight: the first time a tired Prai rises again (once)
rows.text: [serious] The Prai rise again. Bag them while they are tired.

rows.where: the fight: need come, Master Zavier played: first wording
rows.text: [urgent] BIND it before it reaches you.

rows.where: the fight: need come, Master Zavier played: second wording
rows.text: [firm] BIND the Prai that comes.

rows.where: the fight: need waveSafe (ready, a Prai bound, nothing free near him): first wording
rows.text: [serious] The golden shockwave is ready. SHOCKWAVE.

rows.where: the fight: needs waveSafe and waveGo, Grandmaster Pho played: the short one
rows.text: [firm] SHOCKWAVE.

rows.where: the fight: need tired, Master Zavier played: first wording
rows.text: [firm] Switch to me. Bag it.

rows.where: the fight: need tired, Master Zavier played: second wording and the short one
rows.text: [firm] To me. Bag it.

rows.where: the fight: need athimF (Grandmaster Pho played; a Prai at him that the fire can chase off): first wording
rows.text: [urgent] It is at Zavier. FIRE.

rows.where: the fight: need athimF: second wording
rows.text: [urgent] Chase it off him. FIRE.

rows.where: the fight: need athimS (Grandmaster Pho played; at him, a Prai that slips the fire): first wording
rows.text: [urgent] It slips the fire. Switch to Zavier.

rows.where: the fight: need come, Grandmaster Pho played: first wording
rows.text: [urgent] It comes for Zavier. Switch to Zavier.

rows.where: the fight: need athimB (Master Zavier played; a Prai at him): first wording
rows.text: [urgent] It is at you. BIND.

rows.where: the fight: need athimB: second wording
rows.text: [firm] BIND the Prai at you.

rows.where: the fight: need athimSw (Master Zavier played; at him, his BIND far off): first wording
rows.text: [calm] Switch to me. I will chase it off.

rows.where: the fight: need waveGo (his cage lent; Master Zavier played): first wording
rows.text: [firm] Now switch to me.

rows.where: the fight: needs waveGo and athimSw, Master Zavier played: second wording and the short one
rows.text: [urgent] To me. Now.

rows.where: the fight: need waveGo, Grandmaster Pho played: first wording
rows.text: [firm] Now. SHOCKWAVE.

rows.where: the fight: need bound, Grandmaster Pho played: second wording
rows.text: [firm] It is bound. FIRE.

rows.where: the fight: need keep (Master Zavier played; a tired Prai whose ring is half closed): first wording
rows.text: [serious] It will rise again. BIND it, and it cannot.

rows.where: the fight: need keep: second wording
rows.text: [calm] BIND the tired Prai. Keep it for the bag.

rows.where: the fight: need shown, Master Zavier played: second wording
rows.text: [firm] BIND the Prai you found.

rows.where: the fight: every need that sends the player from Grandmaster Pho to Master Zavier: the short one
rows.text: [firm] Switch to Zavier.

rows.where: the fight: need shown, Grandmaster Pho played: first wording
rows.text: [calm] Zavier has found it. Switch to Zavier, and BIND it.

rows.where: the fight: needs shown, come, press and waveB, Grandmaster Pho played: second wording
rows.text: [firm] Switch to Zavier. BIND.

rows.where: the fight: need waveLend, Grandmaster Pho played: first wording (waveL's second)
rows.text: [calm] Switch to Zavier, and lend me your cage.

rows.where: the fight: need waveLend, Grandmaster Pho played: second wording
rows.text: [firm] Lend me your cage first.

rows.where: the fight: need waveLend, Master Zavier played: first wording (waveL's second)
rows.text: [calm] Lend me your cage, Zavier.

rows.where: the fight: need waveLend, Master Zavier played: second wording
rows.text: [serious] The golden shockwave is ready. LEND.

rows.where: the fight: needs waveLend and waveL, Master Zavier played: the short one
rows.text: [firm] LEND.

rows.where: the fight: need slip, Grandmaster Pho played: first wording
rows.text: [calm] That Prai slips the fire. Switch to Zavier.

rows.where: the fight: need slip (and athimS), Grandmaster Pho played: second wording
rows.text: [firm] Only Zavier can hold it. Switch to Zavier.

rows.where: the fight: need slip, Master Zavier played: first wording
rows.text: [firm] BIND the one that slips.

rows.where: the fight: need slip, Master Zavier played: second wording
rows.text: [calm] BIND it, and the fire will hold.

rows.where: the fight: praise: the lesson's Prai bagged (once)
rows.text: [warm] Good.

rows.where: the fight: praise: the first bound Prai tired in the fight proper (once)
rows.text: [warm] Bind, then fire. That is how it is done.

rows.where: the fight: praise: the first golden shockwave, when it has gathered (once)
rows.text: [warm] You held. Remember how that felt.

rows.where: the fight: praise: the lesson's shown Prai bound (once)
rows.text: [warm] You found it, and you held it.

rows.where: the fight: the surge: need together, first wording
rows.text: [urgent] Together, Zavier. Now.

rows.where: the fight: the surge: need together, the short one
rows.text: [firm] Together.

rows.where: the fight: the last three, as stage 6 opens (moved from the surge)
rows.text: [calm] Three Prai. Do not hurry.

rows.where: the fight: the Naga's film (the film's line, not the rules')
rows.text: [serious] The Naga guards. It always has.

rows.where: the fight: the last three (once)
rows.text: [gentle] Bag them. Gently.

rows.where: the fight: the last bag
rows.text: [gentle] Come. It is over for you too.

rows.where: the fight: the fight lost (said as the card opens)
rows.text: [gentle] Enough. Breathe. We begin again.

rows.where: the fight: at START, a player brought up to 40
rows.text: [warm] Breathe. You are safe beside me.

rows.where: the fight: at START (thought)
rows.text: [reflective] I could see. I could hear. I was not the one standing.

rows.where: the fight: five left (thought)
rows.text: [shaken] I could hear my own voice, and the words were not mine.

rows.where: the fight: the surge (thought)
rows.text: [shaken] It stood over me.

rows.where: the fight: a fireball or a bubble on a stale cloud (thought, once)
rows.text: [quiet] It had already moved.

rows.where: the fight: after the first golden shockwave, in the relief (thought, once)
rows.text: [reflective] I gave my teacher my cage. For a moment there was nothing round me.

rows.where: the fight: the first BIND (thought, once)
rows.text: [awed] My hand rose by itself. And the thing was held.

rows.where: the fight: at START
rows.text: [concerned] Brother has gone quiet. Look at his lips.

rows.where: the fight: the first fireball
rows.text: [puzzled] Who is he talking to? There is nobody there.

rows.where: the fight: answering Mr Koh
rows.text: [firm] Stay behind the thread, Mr Koh.

rows.where: the fight: the first golden shockwave goes out
rows.text: [awed] Did you feel that? Like a door slammed.

rows.where: the fight: the cage first under a quarter
rows.text: [afraid] Master. Brother is shaking.

rows.where: the fight: the surge
rows.text: [afraid] The lamps. Master, the lamps.

rows.where: the fight: the Naga's film, its end (the film's line)
rows.text: [awed] It is... warm. Why is it warm?

rows.where: the fight: the played one walks to the doorway (once)
rows.text: [concerned] Stay there, brother.

rows.where: film, the bag tied: low, shaken, half laughing
rows.text: [shaken] Brother. Before he took it from me. It was shaking. In my hands. Like it was spitting fireballs.

rows.where: film, the bag tied: to Ton
rows.text: [gentle] I believe you felt it.

rows.where: film, the bag tied: his windows open
rows.text: [hopeful] It is... lighter. Is it lighter? Or is it me.

rows.where: film, the bag tied: to Mr Koh
rows.text: [warm] Both can be true.

rows.where: film, the bag tied: after Mr Koh's wai
rows.text: [gentle] Mend what you can with the people you quarrelled with. Not because of tonight. Because it is right.

rows.where: film, the bag tied: to Mr Koh
rows.text: [warm] And if you still do not sleep, see a doctor. And let the electrician come a fourth time.

rows.where: film, the bag tied: at the lift
rows.text: [curious] Grandmaster. The smell. Was it real?

rows.where: film, the bag tied: at the lift
rows.text: [calm] You smelled it. They did not. That is a fact about you. It is not yet a fact about that house.

rows.where: film, the bag tied: at the lift
rows.text: [serious] Your nose is open. Last time it was your sight. An open door is not a skill.

rows.where: film, the bag tied: as the lift's doors open
rows.text: [casual] Master, the man with the collection. He called again. Tomorrow, three o'clock?

rows.where: film, the bag tied: to Jun
rows.text: [calm] Tomorrow.

rows.where: film in, the collector: laying his pieces out
rows.text: [nervous] Twenty. Twenty-one, with this one. I started with one.

rows.where: film in, the collector: after a small laugh
rows.text: [tired] Lately nothing goes right. I am tired all the time. And there is a smell. At home, in the car. I clean, it comes back. You will think I am mad.

rows.where: play, the table: SMELL, the threads rise from the pieces
rows.text: [reflective] I caught it too. It was not coming from anywhere in the room. It was coming from them.

rows.where: play, the table: the angry one looked at
rows.text: [serious] Angry.

rows.where: play, the table: the hungry one looked at
rows.text: [gentle] Hungry.

rows.where: play, the table: the one looking for energy looked at
rows.text: [gentle] This only wants warmth. It does not know where it is.

rows.where: play, the table: all three looked at
rows.text: [worried] Is it these? Is this why I am sick?

rows.where: play, the table: to the man's face, at once (so it is said in every ending)
rows.text: [serious] Your health: see a doctor. That comes first, whatever we find on this table. Both can be true.

rows.where: play, the table
rows.text: [sheepish] My wife says the same.

rows.where: play, the table: looking down at his rows
rows.text: [defensive] All right. But some of these must be fine. I chose them one by one.

rows.where: play, the table: to the student; the decision opens on it
rows.text: [hopeful] You. You can tell. Which ones can I keep?

rows.where: play, the table: SMELL not pressed, 25 s, then every 15 s
rows.text: [firm] SMELL.

rows.where: play, the table: his Spirit Vision not opened, 30 s, then every 20 s
rows.text: [calm] Look, so that you know what you are answering.

rows.where: the decision: 30 s without an answer (once)
rows.text: [gentle] Take your time. I am not going anywhere.

rows.where: ending A: he flinches, then nods
rows.text: [surprised] All? Even the ones that did nothing?

rows.where: ending A
rows.text: [firm] All.

rows.where: ending A: at the door, after the rite
rows.text: [eager] So where do I buy good ones? You have a shop, right?

rows.where: ending A: to the collector
rows.text: [calm] First learn what you are asking for. Then ask.

rows.where: ending A: when he has gone
rows.text: [gentle] He gave them up because you said so. You were right. He does not yet know why.

rows.where: ending A
rows.text: [regretful] He will buy again. I gave him an answer, and no question.

rows.where: ending B: the first row
rows.text: [proud] This one a dealer in Bangkok sold me. He said it was strong.

rows.where: ending B: the second
rows.text: [embarrassed] This... came in a lot of five. I never asked.

rows.where: ending B: the third, turned over twice
rows.text: [confused] I do not know what this is.

rows.where: ending B: his hand on the fourth
rows.text: [thoughtful] I do not know what half of them are.

rows.where: ending B: at the door, after the rite
rows.text: [thoughtful] If I ever buy another...

rows.where: ending B: answering him
rows.text: [gentle] Ask it those two questions first.

rows.where: ending B: after he has gone
rows.text: [warm] You did not tell him what they were. You let him find out that he did not know. That is the only way it stays learned.

rows.where: ending B
rows.text: [quiet] He put them down himself.

rows.where: ending C: delighted
rows.text: [delighted] Three! Only three.

rows.where: ending C: his hand flat on the case's lid
rows.text: [calm] This one. What is it?

rows.where: ending C
rows.text: [embarrassed] I... do not know.

rows.where: ending C: to the student, mildly
rows.text: [gentle] Nor does he. Your nose is not a certificate.

rows.where: ending C
rows.text: [ashamed] I sorted his collection by a smell. I would have sent him home with seventeen things neither of us understood.

rows.where: ending D: his face clears
rows.text: [excited] Yes. Yes! I know a man. Proper monks' pieces, all blessed. I can have twenty by Friday.

rows.where: ending D: to the collector
rows.text: [calm] Twenty more things you do not understand, in the same case.

rows.where: ending D: to the student
rows.text: [serious] It is not the kind. A blessed piece kept as he kept these is kept the same way.

rows.where: ending D
rows.text: [regretful] I gave him a rule about objects. The trouble was never the objects.

rows.where: every ending, after the rite
rows.text: [relieved] I feel lighter. My head is quieter.

rows.where: every ending, the last picture: the black bag on the white cloth
rows.text: [reflective] Understanding first. Then possession.

rows.where: under the outcome card, ending A
rows.text: [reflective] I told him to let them all go. He did, and did not know why.

rows.where: under the outcome card, ending B
rows.text: [quiet] I asked him what each one was. He found he did not know.

rows.where: under the outcome card, ending C
rows.text: [ashamed] I sorted his pieces by a smell. My nose is not a certificate.

rows.where: under the outcome card, ending D
rows.text: [regretful] I gave him a rule about kinds. It was never the kind.
